text: In LTL, what does the formula G φ assert about an execution trace?
choices: φ holds at the next state
φ holds at some future state
φ holds at every state of the trace (always)
φ holds until some other condition becomes true
explanation: G ('globally/always') means φ holds at all positions of the trace. Choice 0 is X (next), choice 1 is F (eventually/finally), and choice 3 is the U (until) operator. A frequent error is reading G as 'eventually' — that is F.
